name: What is the difference between a relocation service and a traditional real estate agent in Fort Lauderdale?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a relocation service and a traditional real estate agent in Fort Lauderdale?

acceptedAnswer.text: A traditional real estate agent primarily assists with buying or selling property. A relocation service, while often including real estate assistance, typically offers a broader range of support to help individuals and families transition to a new location. Kelby Contreras, as a real estate agent specializing in relocation, combines both by focusing on the real estate transaction while also providing guidance specific to moving to areas like Fort Lauderdale. We leverage our knowledge of Broward County and other service areas to help clients not just find a house, but also integrate into their new community, often streamlining the property search and closing process for those new to the area.
acceptedAnswer.description: A relocation service offers broader support for moving, while a traditional real estate agent focuses on property transactions. Kelby Contreras combines both, specializing in real estate for those relocating to Fort Lauderdale, providing market knowledge and community integration guidance.
